name.value: BC Golf Museum and Hall of Fame

description.value: The BC Golf Museum and Hall of Fame chronicles the history of golf in British Columbia, honouring the province's notable players, courses, and contributors to the sport. Located in Point Grey near UBC, it sits along routes popular with Vancouver-area cyclists. A touring cyclist passing through the area would find it a compact cultural stop in a quiet residential neighbourhood.
